Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot window & deployment preference — quick check

Simon — thanks again for the call this morning. Wanted to capture the quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned.

Recap (30 min discovery):
- Primary goal: integrate Redwood inference into Finlytics document ingestion pipeline for real-time summarization and redaction.
- Target SLA: 200ms p50, spikes to 600ms p99 acceptable for short bursts; throughput ~20 req/s steady.
- Data concerns: must remain in-customer VPC for PII pathways; SOC 2 evidence required for legal review.
- Constraint: procurement window aligned with Q3 budget — pilot ideally in May/June.

Recommendations I mentioned:
1) Pilot on Dedicated (reserved GPU pool) inside your VPC (Redwood Private) to meet isolation + perf targets.
2) Start with 2-week smoke + 4-week pilot measuring latency and cost metrics; SLOs + rollback plan.

Proposed next steps:
- I can share a one-page Dedicated / Private overview + SOC2 snapshot (attached).
- Lauren to follow up on integration checklist (networking, sample payloads, auth).
- If procurement needs a cost estimate for the pilot, I’ll loop in our pricing specialist.

Would you prioritize the pilot for May? If so, what weeks are likely for an ops kickoff? If procurement prefers a later start, we can align dates and I’ll send an updated timeline.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 15-minute sync if helpful.

— Rachel
